title: AARO head John Kosloski came from the NSA
summary: Jesse Michels tells of AARO head John Kosloski came from the NSA, about present at AARO, US, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And the current uh head of that, it was a former NSA director.

plain: A podcast host named Jesse Michels says that the current head of AARO, a Pentagon office set up to look into reports of unidentified objects in the sky, is a man named John Kosloski who came from the NSA, the US National Security Agency, which intercepts and analyses communications. Michels calls him a former NSA director. He points this out because, if true, it would mean the office studying UFOs is led by someone from the world of secret signals intelligence.
